content.text: Our purge script takes eleven minutes and half of it is redundant. Make it selective.

The script purges the whole zone on every deploy, which is why it takes eleven minutes. What actually goes stale after a deploy is a small set: the html pages whose copy changed, and the social preview image that each of those pages points at. Everything else is content hashed already. So the selective version diffs the build output, collects the changed pages plus the social preview image belonging to each one, and purges that list instead of the zone.
Selective purge runs in 40 seconds on a typical deploy.
